notes.title: Screaming issue has been fixed between Server and Client.
notes.notes:
There were some problems with the enemy shouting. These problems were not working synchronously in server-client connections. This problem has been fixed.

If you are having problems with the server in the game, it may be caused by Steam's save session. Please navigate to the appdata folder with %appdata%. Delete the Bagel file from Local and re-download the game.

notes.title: Scream Sound Issue Fixed
notes.notes: If you are having problems joining the lobby in the game, it is caused by the local save of the Steam Online Subsystem. Delete the game and reinstall it from scratch. Go to my computer and find the local in %appdata% and eliminate the session information stored in the Bagel folder. For this, you can delete the Bagel folder. This can happen after the patch. We welcome your feedback and opinions. Please share our mistakes with us so we can create a better experience

notes.title: New Levels, Special Traps, New Weapons & Exciting Animations in Bagel!
notes.notes:
Dear Bagel Players,

We are thrilled to announce an exciting update! We've added a new level to our game: School Court. We hope you'll enjoy the Basketball Court level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985418/a95e8fae83354c158b7292fbe92de5eb8399d435.png[/img]

Every level in our game is now filled with its own special traps. In the Classroom level, watch out for Bear Traps; in the Basketball Court level, get ready to dodge basketball-themed traps!

Be cautious when encountering these traps. They can cause serious damage or provide strategic advantages, such as immobilizing enemies or dealing damage. We aim for each level to have its unique dynamics and continue to enhance our updates.

With these customized traps, we've made the game experience even more thrilling. We can't wait for you to tackle these new challenges!

Don't forget to share your thoughts and feedback on the update. Remember, the game's new maps and traps are shaped by your ideas. Wishing you success in this adventure filled with new traps!

[b]New Weapons:[/b]
[list]
[*] Katana
[*] Axe
[*] Hot Dog
[*] Aubergiene
[/list]

[b]New Special Traps:[/b]
[list]
[*] Basketball Ball
[*] Bear Trap
[/list]

[b]New Level:[/b]
[list]
[*] School Court
[/list]

[b]New Animations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Taunt
[*] Flat Fall
[*] Knockdown
[*] Slip and Fall
[/list]

Best regards,
Bahadır NURAL

notes.title: Bagel Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985418/09e249a8c54a34f3af4a3c99a45a1fb531841382.png[/img]
[b]We are Coming Soon![/b]
Bagel is coming soon as an online game that can be played by 2-5 people! Bagel plans to feature new maps, new weapons and new traps monthly. Your ideas are very important to us as we prepare the game's new maps, new weapons and traps. It was a great pleasure for us to design this game online, which we played on the street as a child. We will be waiting for your feedback with the excitement of growing this game together. Bagel will be with you soon!
